statements.impact_statement: CVE-2024-34069 affects the Werkzeug interactive debugger, which can execute code if a developer interacts with an attacker-controlled domain while the debugger is active. ReportAudit never enables the debugger: app/servicio.py, line 64, starts the service with app.run(host="127.0.0.1", ..., debug=False), and there is no other call to app.run, no use of werkzeug.debug.DebuggedApplication and no FLASK_DEBUG setting in the repository. The vulnerable code is therefore not in the execute path. werkzeug is a transitive dependency (via flask) and will still be upgraded to 3.1.9 with the Dependabot security update in part M.5.
